title: A Good Plan is Hard to Find: Aligning Models with Preferences is Misaligned with What Helps Users
reasoning: The paper investigates whether standard alignment proxies like user preferences actually correspond to helpfulness in solving multi-step tasks. While the paper includes an 'Ethical Considerations' section regarding participant compensation and data privacy, its core research focuses on math and trivia problem-solving and does not involve benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
